summary: Reproduced all four findings on base eae8c3d2 with failing tests first, then fixed and proved green. R1: engine exec_cost called commission_cash_usd(1) dropping quantity (ES qty3 roundtrip $4.48 vs required $13.44) and zeroed ALL known fees when any commission component was missing (CL $0.00/side vs known $0.85) while cost_incomplete only covered commission components (NOT_RUN slippage left records complete-flagged) -> quantity-scaled commissions, allow_incomplete_costs law covering ALL cost components with NULL+source-class disclosure for missing ones, fail-fast refusal at construction when allow_incomplete_costs=False on an incomplete book. R2: roll old-leg gross (275 in the es_universe repro) vanished from journal records (ledger 700 vs journal 425; net 691.04 vs 416.04) -> lifecycle gross_segments accumulation incl. roll fees, per-contract mae_mfe_segments, per-bar AND end-of-run reconciliation of journal<->cash<->events<->inventory<->MTM with the ledger checked against an INDEPENDENT recomputation from journal records (CashLedger.sums_by_kind). R3: end-of-session roll ran BEFORE intraday barriers, firing the gap-rebased stop off the OLD bar's low and filling on the NEW contract at 184.75 outside its [198,205] range (MAE -5612.5 cross-frame) -> barriers evaluate on the OLD position/contract first (old-bar extrema only; stopped positions never roll; repro now exits 94.75 on ESH6, 0 rolls, gross -275, MAE -512.5), TIME exit also precedes the roll, and the new contract's segment counts bars only AFTER the close-time roll fill. R4: stop-market fills at the barrier even when the bar gapped through it (long SL95 into O80/H90/L70/C85 filled 94.75, outside the bar) -> stop reference = open when gapped (long min(o,sl) / short max(o,sl)) with adverse cost shift after (long stop never fills above open); TP is a limit (barrier or better: long max(o,tp) / short min(o,tp)); same-bar TP+SL stays AMBIGUOUS_ORDER with gap-aware scenario bounds, order never inferred from OHLC. Review-extra items typed in code/README.md execution-disclosures section (8 items: expiry/last-contract wall IMPLEMENTED/TESTED; finite-OHLC validation IMPLEMENTED/TESTED engine-side incl. non-chain per-conid bars; date-vs-release PIT NOT_IMPLEMENTED; same_close PARTIAL with entry-same_close honestly NOT_IMPLEMENTED; MTM/DD/margin/portfolio caps NOT_IMPLEMENTED scaffold; roll-gap no-double-count IMPLEMENTED/TESTED; serial-vs-quarterly spread selection NOT_IMPLEMENTED; risk-cap freeze law NOT_IMPLEMENTED engine-side). Also added Decision.qty validation (integer >= 1). 35 new adversarial tests (5 files); full suite 211 OK (147 base + 35 EXEC-FIX + 29 concurrent WF-PIT-FIX lane) with 0 regressions.
